notes: Two written *for*s are counted against three לְ morphemes; the appositional לַנּוֹתָרִים is the one left unrendered (rules 40, 42).
*them* answers to the suffix of לָהֶם under rule 18, so the article on נּוֹתָרִים takes only the relative *that* — unlike JDG.21.16, where no suffix competes and the article takes *them that*.
לְבִלְתִּי divides with *that* on the לְ and *not* on בִּלְתִּי, a negative morpheme standing in the clause to carry it (rule 48).
